references.text: Kedesh is also mentioned as a city in the territory of the tribe of Naphtali, showing that several cities had the same name in different tribal territories in Israel.
Hazor (Chatsor) was a significant Canaanite city that Joshua conquered. The city mentioned here in the territory of Judah may be another city with the same name.
Chatsar-Addar is mentioned in the description of Israel's borders and is related to the Hazor names found in several places throughout the land.
Kedesh in Naphtali was an important city where Barak gathered his forces, highlighting the significance of cities named Kedesh in Israel's history.
